与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。

People around Ben often share different ideas about the city park. Little by little, things began to change. The city park looked quieter than usual that evening. What's more, the runners redoubled their training before the spring marathon.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The experience taught Ben more than any book could. Ben's dream job is to be a doctor. What's more, well-rotted manure feeds the squash bed.

At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. On Sunday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. Ben has practiced football for three years and won a prize last term. The old boiler broke down again on the coldest night.

Ben is saving money to buy a ticket to Sydney. The camping site has become an important part of daily life. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The storm reshaped the sandy shoreline.
Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
